summary: Full backend + frontend testing of MANI SCHOOL ERP multi-tenant SaaS. Wrote 32 pytest tests covering auth (JWT httpOnly cookies), founder school creation, critical multi-tenancy isolation (School A vs School B cross-access all returns 403 as required), users CRUD, role permission matrix, classes/sections/subjects, attendance (teacher assigned-class enforcement + student/parent scoping), dashboard stats, audit logs, and soft-delete. All 32 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified for founder login/dashboard/schools list/logout, session survival across refresh, School Admin login with correct role-based sidebar (no Schools nav visible), Student login with limited nav (Dashboard/Attendance/Profile only), Parent login with Children nav. Universal login auto-routes by role correctly.

issues: Uses browser-native <input type='date'> picker instead of shadcn Calendar component. Consistent but per platform guideline shadcn Calendar is preferred.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace native date input on Attendance page with shadcn Calendar/Popover for design consistency.

OPTIONAL: routes_dashboard.founder recent_activity returns raw audit_logs with datetime timestamp fields but converts _id — works fine; consider adding school_id/name enrichment for founder recent activity.
critical_code_review_comments: auth cookies use SameSite=none & Secure -> correct for cross-origin ingress; verified via curl the httpOnly flags set.
bcrypt hash format verified starts with $2b$ (bcrypt.gensalt default).
Multi-tenant enforcement via assert_school_access() consistently applied on GET/PUT/DELETE for users and academics; sections additionally verify class belongs to same school.
Brute-force lockout after 5 attempts with 15 min TTL implemented; reset-password clears login_attempts by email (matches playbook).
forgot-password returns identical response for registered/unregistered emails; token stored as sha256 hash — matches playbook.
seed_founder is idempotent (updates password on change) — matches playbook.
MongoDB _id excluded via public_user() and per-route ser() helpers everywhere; no leaks.
CORS uses explicit FRONTEND_URL origin (not '*') with allow_credentials=True — required for cookie auth.
MINOR: routes_schools.SchoolUpdate uses `name: str = None` (Pydantic v2 style is Optional[str]); works but inconsistent with routes_users which uses Optional[...] properly.
MINOR: routes_attendance.get_attendance doesn't validate class_id belongs to user's school for non-founder admin/principal roles (school_id filter handles it, so isolation still enforced).
